facts.fact: Dossiers & Factos reports that the electronic civil registration and vital statistics system e-SIRCEV was implemented in 2018, without saying how many offices or what share of the country it serves.

INE's Vital Statistics 2024-2025 report, as reported, says the civil registration system registered 8.8% of births in 2025 (8.9% in 2024) and 10.0% of deaths, a national rate not tied to the digital system.

systems.system: e-SIRCEV (Sistema Electronico do Registo Civil e Estatisticas Vitais)

MOZ.note: Only birth and death registration rates are given, not national ID enrolment.
